title: 29 CFR 1910.37 — Maintenance safeguards and operational features for exit routes
current_as_of: eCFR displayed up to date as of 2026-10-16 and last amended 2026-10-14
provenance: Official eCFR presentation; eCFR states that it is authoritative but unofficial
claim_supported: Employee exit routes must be adequately lighted; exits must be visible and marked; line of sight to exit signs must remain visible; emergency safeguards including exit lighting must be in proper working order
material_limitation: Applies to workplaces and employee exit routes; not a complete site-specific building-code fire-code accessibility public-occupancy or legal determination
